facts.fact: UNHCR, with ANATS and CNARR, launched at the Abeche one-stop desk on 21 November 2025 an EU-funded biometric enrolment of Sudanese refugees into the national database to assign adult refugees a National Identification Number (NNI), targeting 15,000 by end-2025 and 50,000 by the end of the PADERCA project.
